description.en:
This dataset groups all the Apertium RDF bilingual dictionaries (see the whole list at  http://datahub.ckan.io/dataset?q=apertium+rdf&organization=oeg-upm). The dictionaries were converted into RDF from their LMF version, which can be found in Meta-Share (http://metashare.upf.edu/). The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). 
The Apertium RDF version has been generated by OEG (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid) jointly with IULA (Universitat Pompeu Fabra).
More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/
